moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-split-bars-title, written here): 6 copies of the title, each clipped to one horizontal strip (1/6 of text height + 4 px). Strip k (top first) slides in from the left for even k, right for odd: x ±380 px (≈120 % of a 320 px frame) → 0, 0.7 s expo.out from 0.32 + 0.06 k s. A 300 × 2 px accent bar at its top runs ahead 0.1 s earlier (0.6 s expo.out), fading 0.7–1.0 s (+0.06 k). At 1.6–1.9 s strips jolt ±5 px and back. Exit 2.55 + 0.04 k s, 0.4 s expo.in, on through to the other side. Loop 3.4 s. Params: số dải (6) · quãng trượt (≈ 120 % khung) · thời gian (0.7 s) · cách nhau (0.06 s).
